basic_info.description: Mid-Century Modern Gem with Bay Views in Bernal Heights. Beautifully renovated mid-century modern home, perfectly situated in the heart of Bernal Heights. Featuring panoramic Bay views from the living room and guest bedroom, this home truly checks all the boxes.    Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including a serene primary suite with an en-suite bath and private yard access. The open-concept dining area seamlessly flows into the updated kitchen, which features brand new stainless steel appliances, a peninsula island with sleek modern lighting, quartz countertops, stylish backsplash, and abundant cabinetry.    White oak hardwood flooring and recessed lighting elevate the interior ambiance, while the low-maintenance yard offers the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. The property also includes a generous 2-car garage with extra storage and a roomy driveway.    Just steps from Precita Park and Bernal Heights Park, and only a few blocks from Cortland Avenue's vibrant restaurants, cafes, and shops. With easy access to Highway 101 and just a 15-minute drive to downtown San Francisco, this exceptional home offers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and style.    Don't miss the opportunity to make this turn-key treasure your own.
